# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional code edits were required in this apply-fixes pass. The round-4 review approved the existing patch set, including the authoritative comammox running-alkalinity budget update, the centralized `MG_N_PER_MEQ_AMMONIA` stoichiometry constant shared across systems, the StageTrace budget-metric gating, and the strengthened nitrification budget/tracing regression coverage.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Re-read the round-4 review result and confirm whether any follow-up amendments remained after the accepted running-budget and shared-constant fixes.
2. [Skipped] Apply any remaining review-requested code or test changes.
3. [Completed] Record the approved validation evidence for the unchanged patch set and carry forward the remaining out-of-scope risks.

## Validation Evidence

- No new validation run was required in this stage because review returned `approved` with no follow-up amendments.
- `cargo fmt --all` had already passed on the approved patch set.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test nitrification_alkalinity` had already passed on the approved patch set.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib` had already passed on the approved patch set, including the shrimp and microfauna surfaces now using the shared `MG_N_PER_MEQ_AMMONIA` constant.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test tracing` had already passed on the approved patch set.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking` had already passed on the approved patch set.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --tests` still reported the pre-existing `save_load_with_active_cycle_state` failure in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:368`.

## Outstanding Risks

- `alkalinity_produced_meq` remains a zero-valued placeholder until denitrification work lands; the bookkeeping surface is ready, but the return path is not implemented yet.
- The broader `cargo test -p tank_core --tests` suite still exposes the pre-existing `save_load_with_active_cycle_state` failure in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs`; that save/load determinism issue remains unresolved and out of scope for this bead.
